name: Room for One More
source:
Enter a world where the line between man and beast is blurred, and secrets of the past lie hidden in the shadows. Take on the role of a young beastman who has fled from the simple life of the countryside in search of a new beginning in the bustling city. Despite facing countless rejections and setbacks, fate brings you together with three unlikely companions who offer an opportunity to you.

Together, you will navigate the twists and turns of city life, uncovering hidden truths and confronting challenges that threaten your very existence. Forge new friendships, unravel secrets, and protect your newfound happiness from unexpected forces that seek to tear it all apart.

Can you break free from your past and insecurities to build a brighter future for yourself? The answer is in your hands. Join us on this heartwarming and thought-provoking journey and discover what lies ahead.

[from [url=https://neekke.itch.io/room-for-one-more]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
进入一个人与兽之间的界限变得模糊的世界，过去的秘密隐藏在阴影中。扮演一名年轻的兽人，逃离乡村的简单生活，在繁华的城市寻找新的开始。尽管面临无数的拒绝和挫折，命运还是让你与三个不太可能的同伴走到一起，为你提供了机会。

你们将一起穿越城市生活的曲折，揭开隐藏的真相，面对威胁你们生存的挑战。建立新的友谊，揭开秘密，并保护你新发现的幸福免受试图将其撕裂的意外力量的影响。

你能摆脱过去和不安全感，为自己创造更光明的未来吗？答案就在你的手中。与我们一起踏上这段温馨又发人深省的旅程，探索未来的发展。

[来自[url=https://neekke.itch.io/room-for-one-more]Itch.io[/url]]
